name: Party Animal and Chemistry Whiz Phasorq

description.value: You've spent a large portion of your waking cycle experimenting with various types of poisons, and as such, you've developed a bit of a tolerance. To properly comprehend the effects of various chemical compounds, you understand, one must have firsthand experience. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against poisons.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
